name: Sales & Lead Qualification Agent
description: Automated lead qualification agent that captures lead information, asks qualifying questions, scores leads, and routes qualified leads to CRM with meeting booking. Unqualified leads receive automated follow-up.

notes.what: Starts your workflow the moment another app sends it data — like a doorbell for your automation
notes.overview: Starts a workflow when an external app, website form, payment system, or internal service sends data to the generated CtrlChecks webhook URL. Captures the request body, headers, query values, and method for the next node.
notes.why: Receives leads from your website forms or ad landing pages.

config.code: return { name: input.name || input.full_name || 'Unknown', email: input.email || '', company: input.company || input.company_name || '', phone: input.phone || input.phone_number || '', source: input.source || 'web', message: input.message || input.notes || '', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };

notes.what: Writes and runs any JavaScript you like to transform or process your data
notes.overview: Run sandboxed JavaScript once against the current workflow data and return the transformed value for downstream nodes.
tips: Always return the value the next node should receive
Default timeout is 5000ms and runtime caps at 30000ms
Use Output Schema such as {"type":"object"} only as a top-level shape hint
JavaScript has no credentials; connect downstream service node accounts separately
Do not paste API keys, tokens, or passwords into code
notes.why: Normalises the different field names lead sources use into one shape.

notes.what: Sends your prompt to OpenAI's ChatGPT and gets back an AI-written response
notes.overview: Calls OpenAI through the legacy LLM adapter. Prompt is the main input; Messages is only a fallback when Prompt is blank. Temperature and Memory are visible legacy fields ignored by the current executor.
notes.why: Scores fit and intent from the lead's own details. The lead data is interpolated into the prompt — without that the model would be scoring nothing.

config.code: try { const content = input.content || input.text || input.response || '{}'; const jsonMatch = content.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); if (jsonMatch) { const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonMatch[0]); return { score: parsed.score || 50, qualified: parsed.qualified !== undefined ? parsed.qualified : (parsed.score >= 60), reasoning: parsed.reasoning || 'No reasoning provided' }; } return { score: 50, qualified: false, reasoning: 'Could not parse score' }; } catch (e) { return { score: 50, qualified: false, reasoning: 'Error parsing score: ' + e.message }; }

notes.why: Extracts the score and qualified flag from the AI's JSON.

notes.what: Makes a yes/no decision: if something is true, go one way; otherwise go another
notes.overview: Makes a yes/no decision from previous-step data and routes matching work through TRUE and non-matching work through FALSE.
tips: Use the builder for normal setup; use JSON mode only when pasting prepared condition objects.
Choose AND when every row must match; choose OR when any row can match.
Use equals for statuses and categories, greater-than operators for numeric thresholds, and contains for text or lists.
Connect both TRUE and FALSE outputs so no business case silently disappears.
notes.why: Splits leads worth a salesperson's time from ones that get nurtured. 60 is the threshold, set in the scoring prompt.

notes.what: Create, update, or find contacts, deals, and companies in HubSpot CRM
notes.overview: Connects to HubSpot CRM to get, list, create, update, delete, search, or bulk-create contacts, companies, deals, and tickets. Only Access Token is vault-backed - Api Key and Credential Id are legacy/unused. Perfect for automating sales, marketing, and support workflows.
notes.why: Creates the contact in HubSpot so a qualified lead lands in your real CRM pipeline, not in a side table nobody works from.

notes.what: Send emails from your Gmail account or read and search messages in your inbox
notes.overview: Send, list, get, or search Gmail messages. Send recipients can be typed manually or extracted from upstream/fallback Google Sheets rows.
tips: Connect Google OAuth in Connections; do not paste tokens into workflow fields
Gmail search syntax: from:, subject:, is:unread, has:attachment
List/Search only return {id, threadId} per message â€” use a Get step with that id for full content
Body is plain text only
Get returns Gmail's raw API message; the body text is base64url-encoded inside message.payload.body.data
Use search to filter messages before getting details
notes.why: Invites a qualified lead to book while their interest is still fresh — the speed here is most of the value.
